sonnet.problem: The card says 'Something has been striking down the Israelites.' Verse 8 only says the plague 'was halted.' The text doesn't say the plague had been striking them down before this point, so the card adds to the text. It also hints at the next fill-in-the-blank answer.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes. / Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.

sonnet.problem: The blank asks for the next word in 'covenant of ___' (peace, power or honor). No earlier card gives the baker anything to reason from, so the baker can only guess the wording of the line.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
